title.zh: 轮廓与选择性：离子管方向，自由基管化学
title.en: Profile and selectivity: ions govern direction, radicals govern chemistry

subtitle.en: Radical-to-Ion ratio, IEDF / IADF, Passivation and Mask Budget

body.zh: Profile = Directionality × Surface Chemistry × Passivation Balance
body.en: Profile = Directionality × Surface Chemistry × Passivation Balance

body.zh: Ion Energy决定方向性、清底能力与损伤
body.en: Ion Energy Determines directionality, bottom-clearing capability and damage

body.zh: IADF决定离子角度分布与侧壁撞击比例
body.en: IADF Determines the ion-angle distribution and fraction striking sidewalls

body.zh: Radical-to-Ion决定表面反应速率与聚合/挥发平衡
body.en: Radical-to-Ion Determines surface-reaction rate and the polymerization / volatilization balance

body.zh: Passivation强度决定侧壁保护能力与去除难易
body.en: Passivation strength Determines sidewall protection and removal difficulty

body.zh: Pressure / Temperature /Mask影响物种输运、反应路径与Mask损耗
body.en: Pressure / Temperature / Mask Affects species transport, reaction pathways and Mask loss
Passivation ↑: sidewall protection ↑ Necking and Etch Stop risk ↑

body.zh: Ion Energy↑：底部清除与方向性↑Mask Loss与Damage↑
body.en: Ion Energy ↑: Bottom clearing and directionality ↑ Mask Loss and Damage ↑

body.zh: Pressure↓：方向性↑自由基输运与稳定性窗口改变
body.en: Pressure ↓: Directionality ↑ Radical transport and Stability windows change

body.zh: 离子不是只管物理刻蚀，自由基也不是只管化学；二者在表面反应中协同。
body.en: Ions are not limited to physical etching, And radicals are not limited to chemistry; Both act synergistically in surface reactions.

body.zh: 边界：ICP和CCP都同时提供离子与自由基；最终轮廓由材料、化学、结构与工艺窗口共同决定。
body.en: Boundary: ICP and CCP both supply ions and radicals; the final profile is jointly determined by materials, chemistry, structure and process window.
